definitions.explanation: A drink made from fruit, or more broadly, any soft drink. From English 'juice.'

notes:
ジュース is from English "juice" but in Japanese it can refer to any soft drink, not just fruit juice.

BROADER MEANING IN JAPANESE:
While in English "juice" specifically means fruit juice, Japanese ジュース can include:
- ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ジュース: fruit juice
- ⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧: carbonated drinks
- Soft drinks in general

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦オレンジ→オレンジ：01044_orenji⟧ジュース: orange juice
- ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧ジュース: apple juice
- ⟦ぶどう→ぶどう：01018_budou⟧ジュース: grape juice
- ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧ジュース: tomato juice
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ジュース: vegetable juice

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ジュース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink juice
- ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧ジュース: 100% juice
- ジュース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a drink
